AnnouncementEntryResponse.description: An announcement of `/api/announcements`, and where its window stands at the request.

AnnouncementSeverityResponse.description: How prominently an announcement is shown.

AnnouncementStatusResponse.description: Where the announcement's window stands at the request: not begun, open, or ended.

CoverageUnitResponse.description: What `poolHours` and `poolHoursValued` count: a pool's hours, or over `1h` its tranches.

EmbeddedTokenResponse.description: A token, embedded in another resource's response.

logoUri.description: Logo URL as returned by DAS. `null` unless it is `http` or `https`.

mint.description:
SPL mint address, base58. `null` until the pool's mints are
resolved by yog-context.

name.description:
Display name (e.g. "USD Coin"). `null` for the same reason
as `symbol`.

symbol.description: Symbol (e.g. "USDC"). `null` when DAS returned no metadata.

FreshnessStatusResponse.description: How recent the last indexed event is.

IngestionResponse.description: Whether our ingestion keeps up, judged on the last event it wrote.

lastEventAt.description:
Timestamp of the most recent indexed event, `null` when the database
holds no events yet.

LiquidityChangeEventKindResponse.description: Whether the change added liquidity to the pool or removed it.

LiquidityChangeEventMeteoraDammV2Respons.description: What a DAMM v2 liquidity change says beyond every protocol's: the liquidity it moved.

LiquidityFlowsResponse.description:
The liquidity deposited at the pools' creation, added and removed; the sums skip the
moves not valued.

LiquidityMoveLockResponse.description: The lock a move's transaction puts on a position.

LiquidityMoveResponse.description: One valued liquidity move, with its pool's token symbols.

oneOf.description: The lock its transaction puts on a position; `null` for a move valued before it was measured.

LiquidityTurnoverResponse.description:
How many times the liquidity deposited changed hands over the window, its coverage that of the
volume; `turnover` is `null` without a volume, or a TVL above 0.

LiquidityTurnoverTotalsResponse.description: `liquidity-turnover/totals`: `total` is every volume over every TVL, not a sum of the rows'.

MeteoraDammV2BaseFeeResponse.description: The base fee, named by the `mode` cp-amm writes; a scheduler of 0 periods never moves.

MeteoraDammV2DynamicFeeChangeResponse.description: `disabled`: cp-amm reads parameters all at zero as "turn the dynamic fee off".

MeteoraDammV2DynamicFeeResponse.description: The volatility fee added on top of the base fee.

MeteoraDammV2DynamicFeeStateResponse.description: Whether the pool is created with a dynamic fee.

MeteoraDammV2FeeChangesResponse.description: What a fee update changes, field by field.

MeteoraDammV2FeeParametersResponse.description: The fees a pool is created with.

MeteoraDammV2MarketCapSchedulerResponse.description: A fee that falls as the price rises from its first value.

MeteoraDammV2PermanentLockResponse.description: The position's liquidity locked for good, and the position's total so locked after it.

MeteoraDammV2PoolFeesResponse.description: The pool's fees updated by its operator, and what changed: `null` when the bytes do not decode.

MeteoraDammV2PoolStatusResponse.description: The pool's status set, the raw byte as the program wrote it.

MeteoraDammV2PositionNftResponse.description: The position opened or closed, its owner, and the mint of the NFT that holds it.

MeteoraDammV2PropertiesResponse.description: DAMM v2-only pool properties (baseline §8's satellite table).

baseFeeKind.description:
How the base fee behaves over time, from the on-chain account. `None`
while the pool is unresolved, or for a `BaseFeeMode` this crate does not map.

oneOf.description:
The base fee in force right now, in bps; `feeBps` is the genesis tier, the
top of a decaying curve. `None` without a time scheduler (constant fee,
market-cap scheduler, rate limiter), for an unresolved or slot-activated pool.

feeSchedulerExpired.description:
Whether the decay has finished — `currentFeeBps` will not move again.
`None` under the same conditions as `currentFeeBps`.
⚠️ A zero `period_frequency` stays at its cliff while reporting finished;
cp-amm's `validate` makes it unreachable on chain.

hasDynamicFee.description: Whether a volatility-based dynamic fee sits on top of the base fee.

protocolFeePercent.description:
Fee-split percents (0..=100) from the on-chain pool account: Meteora's
cut and a referrer's cut of the trading fee.

MeteoraDammV2RateLimiterResponse.description: A fee that rises with the size of a swap.

MeteoraDammV2RewardDurationChangeRespons.description: A reward's funding window changed, in seconds.

MeteoraDammV2RewardFundResponse.description:
A reward funded: what the funder sent and what reached the vault, the end of the funding
window, and the emission rate before and after, Q64.64.

rewardDurationEnd.description: `null` when the chain's seconds fall past the year 9999, which RFC 3339 cannot write.

MeteoraDammV2RewardInitializeResponse.description:
A reward set up on its pool: its mint, who funds it, who created it, its rank and the length
of a funding window, in seconds.

MeteoraDammV2RewardWithdrawalResponse.description: A reward amount withdrawn from the pool: the mint and what left.

MeteoraDammV2SplitAmountsResponse.description: What a split moved to the second position.

MeteoraDammV2SplitNumeratorsResponse.description: The numerators of the shares a split moved.

MeteoraDammV2SplitResponse.description:
A position split in two: what moved from the first to the second, both after it, and the
numerators of the shares moved.

MeteoraDammV2TimeSchedulerResponse.description: A fee that falls with the time since activation.

MeteoraDammV2VestingLockResponse.description: The position's liquidity put under a vesting: released at the cliff, then by period.

NetworkResponse.description:
Where the chain is, as the probe last saw it. The probe's endpoint is not
the one ingestion uses: this says nothing about our ingestion.

observedAt.description: When the probe recorded the slot above.

rpcLatencyMs.description:
Round-trip latency of the probe's last `getSlot` call, in ms — the
distance to *that* endpoint, not to the one ingestion uses.

slot.description: Latest Solana slot the probe saw.

What a DAMM v2 creation says beyond every protocol's: who paid, the price range and the
first price (Q64.64), the liquidity, the activation, the fee and pool modes, the token
flags, the amounts deposited — in raw units, the totals including the fees taken — and its
